basics.name: Runguo Li
basics.summary: M.S. student in Information Management at UIUC, working on ML systems for large-scale models: MoE inference engines and expert streaming, KV-cache compression, distributed training and rollout infrastructure, and GPU compiler and kernel-level correctness. 26 public merged pull requests across 16 upstream projects after excluding private repositories, including Kubernetes, UCCL, vLLM, colibri, DeepSpeed, LLVM, SGLang, JAX, FlashAttention, Triton, Megatron-LM, and FlashInfer. Applying to Ph.D. programs in ML systems for Fall 2028.
